frequency_question: How often are successor water treaties signed within 132 days of the expiration of the predecessor?
membership_rule: Includes formal bilateral water-sharing treaties between two states that required a successor agreement upon expiration. Excludes non-binding MOUs or unilateral declarations.
coverage_note: 4 named; believed to be a representative sample of high-stakes transboundary water negotiations.
known_gaps: Limited number of high-stakes transboundary water treaties globally.
skeleton: Total identified bilateral water treaty renewal events involving complex river basins requiring formal negotiation cycles.
multiplier: 4 total events / 4 observed = 100% success rate for renewal, but only 3/4 occurred within a short 4-month window.
validity_reason: Diplomatic norms regarding transboundary water management are slow to evolve.
